_comment: Timing rules. The voice decides every clip's length; only the silences between clips are authored here. gapAfter[n] = frames of visual breathing room after clip n's audio ends and before clip n+1's audio starts. Each clip also carries its own ~0.2 s lead-in and ~0.3-0.5 s tail of silence, so the audible gap is gap + those.
headReason: The first image already moves: a weathered hand hauling a dripping rope in the mist, 1.2 s before the voice.
tailReason: Hold the empty boat and the two far figures for 5 s so the meaning settles, then fade to warm light.

1.why: Intro flows straight into Simon at work.

2.why: A breath of lake ambience before the call.

3.why: The abandoned net rocks in the breeze while Peter shrinks into the distance.

4.why: The montage keeps its momentum into the confession.

5.why: Late sun flares; the glare carries us up the mountain.

6.why: Major turn: divine light to cold night.

7.why: Longer hold (brief: denial realisation may hold): Peter weeping in darkness, the world muffled; tears become the morning lake.

8.why: Restoration settles in the sunrise before Pentecost.

9.why: Continuous walk into the road-to-Rome transition.

10.why: Footsteps outside; everyone frozen; the tension hangs.

11.why: Longer hold (brief: martyrdom may hold): fade through bright sky.

12.why: Candlelight settles into the final remembrance.
